307	def render_pages(county: str, page_numbers, out_dir: Path, data_root=None, max_width=MAX_WIDTH) -> dict:
308	    """Renders each page at 200 dpi (cached by crossfoot.render), saves a WebP at most max_width wide."""

311	    from .sources import DATA
312	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
313	    sizes = {}
314	    for n in page_numbers:
315	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, RENDER_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
316	            rw, rh = im.size
317	            iw = min(max_width, rw)
318	            ih = round(rh * iw / rw)
319	            im.convert("L").resize((iw, ih), Image.LANCZOS).save(out_dir / f"{county}-p{n}.webp", quality=88, method=6)

324	def render_blocks(raw: dict, sizes: dict, out_dir: Path, data_root=None) -> dict:
325	    """Cuts every block that has a box out of its page at 300 dpi and saves it as a grey WebP.
326	    Returns (inks, rules): the ink box of every value that has one, {(page, block, row, column): [x0, y0, x1, y1]},
327	    and the y of the ruled line above each block's first row, {(page, block): y}, both in the pixels of the
328	    block's image."""
329	    from PIL import Image
330	    from .render import page_png
331	    from .sources import DATA
332	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
333	    county, inks, rules = raw["county"], {}, {}
334	    frames = {pg["number"]: (pg.get("width") or sizes[pg["number"]][0], sizes[pg["number"]][0]) for pg in raw["pages"]}
335	    for n in sorted({b["page"] for b in raw["blocks"] if b.get("box")}):
336	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, BLOCK_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
337	            im = im.convert("L")
338	            for b in raw["blocks"]:
339	                if b["page"] != n or not _scale_box(b.get("box"), 1.0):
340	                    continue
341	                geom = block_geometry(b["box"], *frames[n])
342	                cut = cut_block(im, geom)
343	                cut.save(out_dir / f"{county}-{b['id']}.webp", quality=82, method=6)
344	                k = frames[n][1] * BLOCK_DPI / RENDER_DPI / frames[n][0]
345	                left = max(0, min(geom[0], im.width - geom[2]))
346	                top = max(0, min(geom[1], im.height - geom[3]))
347	                first = None
348	                for rows, rk, ck in ((raw["cells"], "row_kind", "column"), (raw["totals"], "direction", "key")):
349	                    for o in rows:
350	                        if o["page"] != n or o["block"] != b["id"] or not _scale_box(o.get("box"), 1.0):
351	                            continue
352	                        cb = [o["box"][0] * k - left, o["box"][1] * k - top, o["box"][2] * k - left, o["box"][3] * k - top]
353	                        if rk == "row_kind" and (first is None or cb[1] < first[1]):
354	                            first = cb
355	                        ib = ink_box(cut, cb)
356	                        if ib:
357	                            inks[(n, b["id"], o[rk], str(o[ck]))] = ib
358	                rt = rule_top(cut, first) if first else None
359	                if rt is not None:
360	                    rules[(n, b["id"])] = rt
361	    return inks, rules

364	def total_seconds(meta: dict, runs_dir="runs"):
365	    """This run's seconds plus those of every run it resumed (`resumed_from`, followed back); None when the run, or
366	    one it resumed, did not record its seconds or its run.json cannot be found."""
367	    total, seen = 0.0, set()
368	    while meta:
369	        if not isinstance(meta.get("seconds"), (int, float)):
370	            return None
371	        total += meta["seconds"]
372	        prior = meta.get("resumed_from")
373	        if not prior:
374	            return round(total, 1)
375	        if prior in seen:
376	            return None
377	        seen.add(prior)
378	        path = Path(runs_dir) / str(prior) / "run.json"
379	        meta = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else None
380	    return None

391	def build(run_id: str, runs_dir="runs", out="site/data", counties=None, data_root=None) -> list[str]:
392	    if run_id == "latest":
393	        run_id = latest_run(runs_dir)
394	    run_dir = Path(runs_dir) / run_id
395	    out = Path(out)
396	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
397	    meta = json.loads((run_dir / "run.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "run.json").exists() else {}
398	    if meta.get("resumed_from"):
399	        tot = total_seconds(meta, runs_dir)
400	        if tot is not None:
401	            meta["seconds_total"] = tot
402	    keys = counties or sorted(p.parent.name for p in run_dir.glob("*/county.json"))
403	    if not keys:
404	        raise SystemExit(f"no county.json under {run_dir}")
405	    index = {"run": run_id, "started": meta.get("started"), "ended": meta.get("ended"), "counties": [], "summary": {},
406	             "run_totals": {k: meta[k] for k in ("model_calls", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens",
407	                                                 "metered_cost_estimate") if k in meta}}
408	    for key in keys:
409	        raw = json.loads((run_dir / key / "county.json").read_text())
410	        sizes = render_pages(key, [p["number"] for p in raw["pages"]], out / "pages", data_root)
411	        inks, rules = render_blocks(raw, sizes, out / "blocks", data_root)
412	        fpath = run_dir / key / "findings.json"
413	        findings = json.loads(fpath.read_text()) if fpath.exists() else None
414	        crops = out / "crops"
415	
416	        def crop_path(county, gid, src, _dir=run_dir / key):
417	            if not src or not (_dir / src).exists():
418	                return None
419	            crops.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
420	            shutil.copyfile(_dir / src, crops / f"{county}-{gid}.png")
421	            return f"data/crops/{county}-{gid}.png"
422	
423	        d = build_county(raw, sizes, ink=inks, rules=rules, findings=findings, run=meta,
424	                         findings_path=fpath.as_posix() if findings else None,
425	                         evidence=f"data/{key}-findings.json" if findings else None, crop_path=crop_path)
426	        if findings:
427	            shutil.copyfile(fpath, out / f"{key}-findings.json")
428	        (out / f"{key}.json").write_text(json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":")))
429	        index["counties"].append({"key": key, "name": key.replace("_", " ").title(), "file": f"data/{key}.json",
430	                                  "pages": len(d["pages"])})
431	        index["summary"][key] = raw.get("summary", {})
432	    (out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, separators=(",", ":")))

"""Report layout (San Saba, Cottle and others): one precinct per section, one row per candidate with four numbers.

Reading: the county's layout is decided from its first page (`profile.decide_layout`); the first page is read under that
decision and the decision is thrown away if more than a third of its row sums fail. The same sample chooses the reader
(`profile.decide`). One page per model call at 200 dpi, strict JSON, one repair request.

The ledger: a cell is (page, block, row, column). A block is one contest on one precinct, `block_id` "<precinct key>|<n>"
(a contest that runs over a page break is one block: its cells carry different pages and the same block id); the Statistics
rows "Ballots Cast - Total" and "Ballots Cast - Blank" are blocks of their own, named as the published file names them.
`row_kind` is the row's label as printed, `column` is total | absentee | early | election_day. A cell's box is the row's
strip of the page at 200 dpi ([0, y - 20, x_right, y + 20]; y is the model's own estimate, so the box is approximate and
re-read crops are cut with generous padding).

Checks (`checks.report_checks`): each row's total = absentee + early voting + election day; where a contest prints a total
row ("Total Votes Cast", "Cast Votes"), the candidates' figures in a column add to that row's figure in the column. A value
sits on its row's own sum, and, only where the page prints a contest total, on the column's sum too.

# ---- names: both sides are normalised before they are compared ---------------------------------------------------------

def precinct_key(name) -> str:
    """"PRECINCT 101", "Precinct 101" and "101" are one precinct; so are "Precinct 2A", "2A" and "02a"."""
    s = re.sub(r"\b(?:precinct|pct)\b", " ", str(name or ""), flags=re.I)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s.lower())
    return re.sub(r"^0+(?=\d)", "", s)


def contest_canon(label) -> str:
    """A contest's name with the scan's and the file's spellings made one: "Pl 2" = "PI 2", "Dist" = "District" (the word
    is dropped on both sides)."""
    s = re.sub(r"\b(?:district|dist)\b", " ", str(label or "").lower())
    s = re.sub(r"\bp[il](?=\s*\d)", "pl", s)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)


_PARTY = re.compile(r"^(REP|DEM|LIB|GRN|IND|NPA|UNA|NON)\s+(.+)$")

def split_label(label) -> tuple[str, str]:

"""Page rendering with pdftoppm, and crops with Pillow."""
from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from .sources import DATA, scan_path


class RenderError(Exception):
    pass


def page_png(key: str, page: int, dpi: int = 200, root: Path = DATA) -> Path:
    """Render one page (1-based) of a county's scan to data/pages/<key>/pNN-<dpi>.png; cached."""
    out = root / "pages" / key / f"p{page:02d}-{dpi}.png"
    if out.exists():
        return out
    if shutil.which("pdftoppm") is None:
        raise RenderError("pdftoppm is not installed; install poppler-utils (apt install poppler-utils)")
    pdf = scan_path(key, root)
    if not pdf.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"{pdf} is missing; run `crossfoot fetch --county {key}` first")
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", str(dpi), "-f", str(page), "-l", str(page),
                        "-singlefile", str(pdf), str(out.with_suffix(""))],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or not out.exists():
        raise RenderError(f"pdftoppm failed for {pdf} page {page}: {r.stderr.strip()}")
    return out


def crop(png: Path, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], dest: Path) -> Path:
    """Crop (x0, y0, x1, y1) out of an image and save it."""
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with Image.open(png) as im:
        im.crop(box).save(dest)
    return dest

import pytest

from crossfoot.sitebuild import build_county


def raw():
    cell = lambda r, c, v, box: {"page": 1, "block": "b1", "contest": "X", "candidate": "A", "row_kind": r,
                                 "column": c, "value": v, "first_read": v, "status": "accepted", "tries": 0,
                                 "model": "m", "reason": None, "box": box}
    tot = lambda d, k, v, box: {"page": 1, "block": "b1", "direction": d, "key": k, "value": v, "box": box}
    ref = lambda r, c: [1, "b1", r, c]
    return {
        "county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "layout": "matrix",
        "pages": [{"number": 1, "width": 2000, "height": 1000, "dpi": 200}],
        "blocks": [{"id": "b1", "page": 1, "contest": "X", "candidate": "A", "box": [100, 100, 1900, 500]}],
        "cells": [cell("A", "1", 1, [200, 200, 300, 250]), cell("A", "2", 2, None),
                  cell("B", "1", 4, [200, 250, 300, 300]), cell("B", "2", 5, [300, 250, 400, 300])],
        "totals": [tot("row", "A", 3, [1800, 200, 1900, 250]), tot("col", "1", 5, [200, 300, 300, 350]),
                   tot("grand", "", 9, [1800, 300, 1900, 350])],
        "checks": [
            {"kind": "row", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "A", "terms": [[ref("A", "1"), 1], [ref("A", "2"), 2]],
             "printed": 3, "computed": 3, "ok": True},
            {"kind": "col", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "1", "terms": [[ref("A", "1"), 1], [ref("B", "1"), 4]],
             "printed": 5, "computed": 5, "ok": True},
            {"kind": "grand", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "", "terms": [[ref("col", "1"), 5]],
             "printed": 9, "computed": 5, "ok": False}],
        "events": [{"ts": 1.5, "kind": "check", "payload": {"a": 1}}], "summary": {}}


def test_terms_resolve_to_values():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    for ch in d["checks"]:
        for i in ch["t"]:
            v = d["values"][i]
            assert (v["p"], v["b"]) == (ch["p"], ch["b"])
    row = d["checks"][0]
    assert [d["values"][i]["v"] for i in row["t"]] == [1, 2]
    assert d["values"][d["checks"][2]["t"][0]]["r"] == "col"


def test_boxes_are_scaled_and_missing_stays_null():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert d["pages"][0]["sc"] == 0.5 and d["pages"][0]["w"] == 1000
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): x for x in d["values"]}
    assert v[("A", "1")]["x"] == [100.0, 100.0, 150.0, 125.0]
    assert v[("A", "2")]["x"] is None
    assert d["blocks"][0]["x"] == [50.0, 50.0, 950.0, 250.0]
    assert all(x["x"] is None or any(x["x"]) for x in d["values"])


def test_unresolved_term_is_an_error():
    r = raw()
    r["checks"][0]["terms"][0][0] = [1, "b1", "Z", "9"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})


def test_every_block_has_a_300_dpi_image_the_size_of_its_box():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import block_geometry, cut_block
    from PIL import Image
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    b = d["blocks"][0]
    # the box is 1800 x 400 px at 200 dpi, so 2700 x 600 at 300 dpi
    assert abs(b["bi"]["w"] - 2700) <= 1 and abs(b["bi"]["h"] - 600) <= 1
    assert b["bi"]["img"].endswith("tiny-b1.webp")
    # the cut has exactly that size, also when the box touches the page edge
    page = Image.new("L", (3000, 1500), 255)
    assert cut_block(page, block_geometry([100, 100, 1900, 500], 2000, 2000)).size == (b["bi"]["w"], b["bi"]["h"])
    assert cut_block(page, block_geometry([200, 100, 2000, 500], 2000, 2000)).size == (2700, 600)


def test_block_without_a_box_has_no_image():
    r = raw()
    r["blocks"][0]["box"] = None
    assert build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})["blocks"][0]["bi"] is None


def test_ink_box_finds_a_figure_printed_low_and_right_in_a_ruled_cell():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import ink_box
    im = Image.new("L", (200, 100), 255)
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.rectangle([10, 10, 109, 59], outline=0, width=2)        # the ruled cell
    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=0)                    # the figure: low and right
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) == [70, 38, 101, 53]
    # a zero is ink
    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=255)
    dr.ellipse([80, 40, 98, 52], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is not None


def test_ink_box_of_an_empty_ruled_cell_is_none():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import ink_box
    im = Image.new("L", (200, 100), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([10, 10, 109, 59], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is None
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 12, 12]) is None


def test_values_carry_their_ink_box():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, ink={(1, "b1", "A", "1"): [5, 6, 20, 30]})
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): x for x in d["values"]}
    assert v[("A", "1")]["ix"] == [5, 6, 20, 30] and v[("B", "1")]["ix"] is None


def test_rule_top_finds_the_ruled_line_above_a_row():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import rule_top
    im = Image.new("L", (300, 120), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([0, 40, 299, 43], fill=0)
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 44, 120, 90]) == 40
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 100, 120, 119]) is None


def findings_doc():
    ref = lambda r, c: [1, "b1", r, c]
    sums = [{"name": "the cells of precinct 1 add to the small total", "kind": "col", "page": 1, "block": "b1",
             "terms": [{"cell": ref("A", "1"), "value": 1}, {"cell": ref("B", "1"), "value": 4}], "printed": 5,
             "printed_label": "small total printed under the column", "computed_with_scan": 5, "holds_with_scan": True,
             "computed_with_file": 4, "holds_with_file": False}]
    f = lambda i, **kw: {"id": i, "group": "g1", "county": "tiny", "office": "X", "district": "", "party": "",
                         "candidate": "A", "precinct": "1", "part": "early_voting", "file_value": 0, "scan_value": 1,
                         "kind": "wrong_column", "status": "settled_against_file", "reason": "r", "sums": sums,
                         "page": 1, "block": "b1", "box": [200, 200, 300, 250], "crop": "crops/g1.png",
                         "reread": None, "confirmed_by_person": False, **kw}
    return {"county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "file": "x.csv",
            "counts": {"findings": 2, "by_kind": {"wrong_column": 2}, "by_status": {"settled_against_file": 2},
                       "groups": 1, "corrections": 1},
            "findings": [f("f1"), f("f2", part="votes", precinct="9", box=[1, 1, 2, 2], file_value=None,
                               reread={"value": 7}, reread_disagrees=True)],
            "groups": [{"id": "g1", "kind": "wrong_column", "office": "X", "district": "", "candidate": "A",
                        "precincts": ["1"], "page": 1, "block": "b1", "findings": ["f1", "f2"], "crop": "crops/g1.png"}]}


def test_findings_resolve_to_values_and_leave_out_what_is_missing():
    run = {"reader": "m1", "seconds": 60.0, "sample": {"row_sums": 22, "failing": 6, "sampled_with": "m0"}}
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc(), run=run,
                     findings_path="runs/r1/tiny/findings.json", evidence="data/tiny-findings.json",
                     crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: f"data/crops/{county}-{gid}.png")
    fd = d["fd"]
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): i for i, x in enumerate(d["values"])}
    f1, f2 = fd["items"]
    assert f1["ref"] == v[("A", "1")] and d["values"][f1["ref"]]["v"] == 1
    assert f1["row"] == "A" and f1["file"] == 0 and f1["scan"] == 1          # a zero is a value, not a missing one
    assert [d["values"][t[0]]["v"] for t in f1["sums"][0]["terms"]] == [1, 4]
    assert f1["sums"][0]["holds_file"] is False and f1["sums"][0]["with_file"] == 4
    assert "ref" not in f2 and "file" not in f2                               # no place on the sheet, no file value
    assert f2["reread_disagrees"] is True and f2["reread_value"] == 7 and "reread_disagrees" not in f1
    assert fd["groups"][0]["crop"] == "data/crops/tiny-g1.png" and fd["groups"][0]["row"] == "A"
    assert fd["counts"]["confirmed"] == 0 and fd["counts"]["findings"] == 2
    assert fd["path"] == "runs/r1/tiny/findings.json" and fd["evidence"] == "data/tiny-findings.json"
    assert "sums_check" not in fd
    assert fd["figures"] == {"cells": 4, "right_first": 4, "right_after": 0, "disagreements": 2, "settled": 2}
    assert fd["run_info"] == {"reader": "m1", "seconds": 60.0, "sample": run["sample"]}
    assert "run_info" not in build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc())["fd"]


def test_no_findings_file_means_no_fd_and_a_missing_crop_is_left_out():
    assert "fd" not in build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc())
    assert "crop" not in d["fd"]["groups"][0]


def test_sums_check_is_passed_on_when_the_file_has_one():
    doc = findings_doc()
    doc["sums_check"] = {"checked": 3, "failing": 0}
    assert build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=doc)["fd"]["sums_check"] == doc["sums_check"]


def test_terms_without_values_and_the_two_grand_sums():
    r = raw()
    r["checks"][2]["kind"] = "grand_col"
    r["checks"][2]["terms"] = [[1, "b1", "col", "1"]]
    r["checks"].append({"kind": "grand_row", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "", "terms": [[1, "b1", "row", "A"]],
                        "printed": 9, "computed": 3, "ok": False})
    d = build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert [c["k"] for c in d["checks"]] == ["row", "col", "grand", "grand_row"]
    assert d["values"][d["checks"][3]["t"][0]]["r"] == "row"


def test_latest_is_the_newest_run_with_findings(tmp_path):
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import latest_run
    for rid, has in (("20261011-100000", True), ("20261011-110000", True), ("20261011-120000", False)):
        (tmp_path / rid / "c").mkdir(parents=True)
        if has:
            (tmp_path / rid / "c" / "findings.json").write_text("{}")
    assert latest_run(tmp_path) == "20261011-110000"


def test_verdicts_and_the_summary_figures_are_passed_on():
    r = raw()
    r["verdicts"] = [{"sum": "col:1:b1:1", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "verdict": "cannot_verify", "reason": "why", "entity": None}]
    r["summary"] = {"sums_failing_before": {"row": 1}, "model_calls": 3}
    d = build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert d["vd"] == [{"s": "col:1:b1:1", "v": "cannot_verify", "r": "why", "e": None}]
    assert d["sm"] == {"sums_failing_before": {"row": 1}}               # only the figures the replay reads
    bare = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert "vd" not in bare and "sm" not in bare


def test_total_seconds_adds_the_runs_a_run_resumed(tmp_path):
    import json
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import total_seconds
    for rid, meta in (("a", {"seconds": 600.0, "resumed_from": None}), ("b", {"seconds": 100.0, "resumed_from": "a"}),
                      ("c", {"resumed_from": "b"})):
        (tmp_path / rid).mkdir()
        (tmp_path / rid / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta))
    read = lambda rid: json.loads((tmp_path / rid / "run.json").read_text())
    assert total_seconds(read("a"), tmp_path) == 600.0
    assert total_seconds(read("b"), tmp_path) == 700.0
    assert total_seconds({"seconds": 5.0, "resumed_from": "c"}, tmp_path) is None   # c never recorded its seconds
    assert total_seconds({"seconds": 5.0, "resumed_from": "gone"}, tmp_path) is None
    assert total_seconds({"resumed_from": "a"}, tmp_path) is None


def test_the_replay_timeline_follows_the_runs_own_events():
    """qa/t07b/timeline.mjs builds the timeline from the real county data and checks its order and counts against the events."""
    import pathlib, shutil, subprocess
    root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if not node or not (root / "site" / "data" / "panola.json").exists():
        pytest.skip("needs node and the built county data")
    r = subprocess.run([node, str(root / "qa" / "t07b" / "timeline.mjs")], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=root)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout + r.stderr

    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=0)                    # the figure: low and right

    # a zero is ink
    dr.rectangle([70, 38, 100, 52], fill=255)
    dr.ellipse([80, 40, 98, 52], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is not None

    from crossfoot.sitebuild import ink_box
    im = Image.new("L", (200, 100), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([10, 10, 109, 59], outline=0, width=2)
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 110, 60]) is None
    assert ink_box(im, [10, 10, 12, 12]) is None


def test_values_carry_their_ink_box():
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, ink={(1, "b1", "A", "1"): [5, 6, 20, 30]})
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): x for x in d["values"]}
    assert v[("A", "1")]["ix"] == [5, 6, 20, 30] and v[("B", "1")]["ix"] is None


def test_rule_top_finds_the_ruled_line_above_a_row():
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import rule_top
    im = Image.new("L", (300, 120), 255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle([0, 40, 299, 43], fill=0)
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 44, 120, 90]) == 40
    assert rule_top(im, [20, 100, 120, 119]) is None


def findings_doc():

    sums = [{"name": "the cells of precinct 1 add to the small total", "kind": "col", "page": 1, "block": "b1",
             "terms": [{"cell": ref("A", "1"), "value": 1}, {"cell": ref("B", "1"), "value": 4}], "printed": 5,
             "printed_label": "small total printed under the column", "computed_with_scan": 5, "holds_with_scan": True,
             "computed_with_file": 4, "holds_with_file": False}]
    f = lambda i, **kw: {"id": i, "group": "g1", "county": "tiny", "office": "X", "district": "", "party": "",
                         "candidate": "A", "precinct": "1", "part": "early_voting", "file_value": 0, "scan_value": 1,
                         "kind": "wrong_column", "status": "settled_against_file", "reason": "r", "sums": sums,
                         "page": 1, "block": "b1", "box": [200, 200, 300, 250], "crop": "crops/g1.png",
                         "reread": None, "confirmed_by_person": False, **kw}
    return {"county": "tiny", "run_id": "r1", "file": "x.csv",
            "counts": {"findings": 2, "by_kind": {"wrong_column": 2}, "by_status": {"settled_against_file": 2},
                       "groups": 1, "corrections": 1},
            "findings": [f("f1"), f("f2", part="votes", precinct="9", box=[1, 1, 2, 2], file_value=None,
                               reread={"value": 7}, reread_disagrees=True)],
            "groups": [{"id": "g1", "kind": "wrong_column", "office": "X", "district": "", "candidate": "A",
                        "precincts": ["1"], "page": 1, "block": "b1", "findings": ["f1", "f2"], "crop": "crops/g1.png"}]}


def test_findings_resolve_to_values_and_leave_out_what_is_missing():
    run = {"reader": "m1", "seconds": 60.0, "sample": {"row_sums": 22, "failing": 6, "sampled_with": "m0"}}
    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc(), run=run,
                     findings_path="runs/r1/tiny/findings.json", evidence="data/tiny-findings.json",
                     crop_path=lambda county, gid, src: f"data/crops/{county}-{gid}.png")
    fd = d["fd"]
    v = {(x["r"], x["c"]): i for i, x in enumerate(d["values"])}
    f1, f2 = fd["items"]
    assert f1["ref"] == v[("A", "1")] and d["values"][f1["ref"]]["v"] == 1
    assert f1["row"] == "A" and f1["file"] == 0 and f1["scan"] == 1          # a zero is a value, not a missing one
    assert [d["values"][t[0]]["v"] for t in f1["sums"][0]["terms"]] == [1, 4]
    assert f1["sums"][0]["holds_file"] is False and f1["sums"][0]["with_file"] == 4
    assert "ref" not in f2 and "file" not in f2                               # no place on the sheet, no file value
    assert f2["reread_disagrees"] is True and f2["reread_value"] == 7 and "reread_disagrees" not in f1
    assert fd["groups"][0]["crop"] == "data/crops/tiny-g1.png" and fd["groups"][0]["row"] == "A"
    assert fd["counts"]["confirmed"] == 0 and fd["counts"]["findings"] == 2
    assert fd["path"] == "runs/r1/tiny/findings.json" and fd["evidence"] == "data/tiny-findings.json"
    assert "sums_check" not in fd
    assert fd["figures"] == {"cells": 4, "right_first": 4, "right_after": 0, "disagreements": 2, "settled": 2}

    assert "run_info" not in build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc())["fd"]

    d = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=findings_doc())
    assert "crop" not in d["fd"]["groups"][0]


def test_sums_check_is_passed_on_when_the_file_has_one():
    doc = findings_doc()
    doc["sums_check"] = {"checked": 3, "failing": 0}
    assert build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)}, findings=doc)["fd"]["sums_check"] == doc["sums_check"]


def test_terms_without_values_and_the_two_grand_sums():
    r = raw()
    r["checks"][2]["kind"] = "grand_col"
    r["checks"][2]["terms"] = [[1, "b1", "col", "1"]]
    r["checks"].append({"kind": "grand_row", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "key": "", "terms": [[1, "b1", "row", "A"]],
                        "printed": 9, "computed": 3, "ok": False})
    d = build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert [c["k"] for c in d["checks"]] == ["row", "col", "grand", "grand_row"]
    assert d["values"][d["checks"][3]["t"][0]]["r"] == "row"


def test_latest_is_the_newest_run_with_findings(tmp_path):
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import latest_run
    for rid, has in (("20261011-100000", True), ("20261011-110000", True), ("20261011-120000", False)):
        (tmp_path / rid / "c").mkdir(parents=True)
        if has:
            (tmp_path / rid / "c" / "findings.json").write_text("{}")
    assert latest_run(tmp_path) == "20261011-110000"


def test_verdicts_and_the_summary_figures_are_passed_on():
    r = raw()
    r["verdicts"] = [{"sum": "col:1:b1:1", "page": 1, "block": "b1", "verdict": "cannot_verify", "reason": "why", "entity": None}]
    r["summary"] = {"sums_failing_before": {"row": 1}, "model_calls": 3}
    d = build_county(r, {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert d["vd"] == [{"s": "col:1:b1:1", "v": "cannot_verify", "r": "why", "e": None}]
    assert d["sm"] == {"sums_failing_before": {"row": 1}}               # only the figures the replay reads
    bare = build_county(raw(), {1: (2000, 1000, 1000, 500)})
    assert "vd" not in bare and "sm" not in bare


def test_total_seconds_adds_the_runs_a_run_resumed(tmp_path):
    import json
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import total_seconds
    for rid, meta in (("a", {"seconds": 600.0, "resumed_from": None}), ("b", {"seconds": 100.0, "resumed_from": "a"}),
                      ("c", {"resumed_from": "b"})):
        (tmp_path / rid).mkdir()
        (tmp_path / rid / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta))
    read = lambda rid: json.loads((tmp_path / rid / "run.json").read_text())
    assert total_seconds(read("a"), tmp_path) == 600.0
    assert total_seconds(read("b"), tmp_path) == 700.0
    assert total_seconds({"seconds": 5.0, "resumed_from": "c"}, tmp_path) is None   # c never recorded its seconds
    assert total_seconds({"seconds": 5.0, "resumed_from": "gone"}, tmp_path) is None
    assert total_seconds({"resumed_from": "a"}, tmp_path) is None


def test_the_replay_timeline_follows_the_runs_own_events():
    """qa/t07b/timeline.mjs builds the timeline from the real county data and checks its order and counts against the events."""
    import pathlib, shutil, subprocess
    root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if not node or not (root / "site" / "data" / "panola.json").exists():
        pytest.skip("needs node and the built county data")
    r = subprocess.run([node, str(root / "qa" / "t07b" / "timeline.mjs")], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=root)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stdout + r.stderr

        boxes, lb, fh = figure_boxes(im, [0, rows[i][1], x1, rows[i][2]], values=vals)
        keep_fx(p, b, r, boxes, f)
        mid = (rows[i][1] + rows[i][2]) / 2

        ry1 = piece[2] + min(piece[1], rows[i][2]) - piece[0]
        fb = {}

"""Shared bits for the T07b scripts: a static server over site/, and a page opener that collects errors."""
import http.server, socketserver, threading, functools, pathlib
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "qa" / "t07b"
class Quiet(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a, **k): pass
srv = socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), functools.partial(Quiet, directory=str(ROOT / "site")))
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
BASE = f"http://127.0.0.1:{srv.server_address[1]}/"

def open_page(b, w, h, q="", wait=2600, **kw):
    ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": w, "height": h}, **kw); pg = ctx.new_page()
    errs = []
    pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errs.append(str(e)))
    pg.on("console", lambda m: errs.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
    pg.goto(BASE + q, wait_until="load"); pg.wait_for_timeout(wait)
    return ctx, pg, errs

        pg.get_by_role("button", name="Replay the audit").click()

def main(only):

        if want("findings"):
            for key, size in (("1440", W), ("390", M)):
                still(b, size, "?finding=f001", f"cannot-verify-{key}.png")
                still(b, size, "?finding=f010", f"wrong-number-{key}.png")
        if want("replay"):
            replay(b, W, "1440"); replay(b, M, "390")
        if want("reduced"):
            replay(b, W, "1440-reduced", True)
        b.close()

# ---- the report layout (T07c): row crops, figures from the ink, the run's index --------------------------------------------

def page_image():
    """A made-up portrait page at 300 dpi: a contest heading, column headings, six rows of a label and four figures."""
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    im = Image.new("L", (1000, 1400), 255)
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.rectangle([40, 100, 400, 140], fill=0)                       # the contest's title
    dr.rectangle([40, 150, 160, 168], fill=0)                       # "Vote For 1"
    for x in (520, 660, 800, 930):
        dr.rectangle([x - 40, 200, x + 20, 230], fill=0)            # the column headings
    figs = {}
    for r in range(6):
        y = 300 + r * 80                                            # a row pitch of 80 px, the figures 24 px tall
        dr.rectangle([40, y, 300, y + 24], fill=0)                  # the label
        for c, x in enumerate((520, 660, 800, 930)):
            dr.rectangle([x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 10, y + 24], fill=0)
            figs[(r, c)] = [x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 11, y + 25]
        dr.line([40, y + 38, 960, y + 38], fill=200, width=1)       # a dotted rule is a faint line
    return im, figs


def test_the_heading_starts_after_the_blank_band_above_it():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import heading_top, _dark
    im, _ = page_image()
    dark, _ = _dark(im, [0, 0, 1000, 1400])
    ink = dark.sum(axis=1) >= 3
    assert heading_top(ink, 295) == 100                              # the title's first row, not the paper above it
    assert heading_top([False] * 400, 300) == 130                    # nothing found: a fixed reach above the row


def test_a_deep_row_gets_the_heading_and_its_own_neighbourhood_as_two_pieces():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import row_pieces, cut_pieces, to_crop, to_page, _dark, SPACER
    im, _ = page_image()
    dark, _ = _dark(im, [0, 0, 1000, 1400])
    ink = dark.sum(axis=1) >= 3
    strips = [(290 + r * 80, 335 + r * 80) for r in range(6)]
    top = row_pieces(strips, 0, ink)
    assert len(top) == 1 and top[0][0] == 100                        # a row near the top: heading and rows in one piece
    deep = row_pieces(strips, 5, ink)
    assert len(deep) == 2 and deep[0][1] <= 300                      # the heading ends above the first row
    assert deep[1][0] >= 480 and deep[1][1] <= 1400                  # two rows above the row, none below (it is the last)
    crop, parts = cut_pieces(im, deep, 960)
    assert crop.height == sum(b - a for a, b in deep) + SPACER
    # nothing is drawn into the crop: every pixel of it is a pixel of the page, or white
    assert to_page(parts, 50, to_crop(parts, 50, 700)[1]) == (50, 700)
    assert to_crop(parts, 5, 5) is None
    band = crop.crop((0, parts[0][1] - parts[0][0], 960, parts[0][1] - parts[0][0] + SPACER))
    assert band.getextrema() == (255, 255)


def test_figures_are_found_from_the_ink_right_to_left_and_a_wrong_count_gives_none():
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import figure_boxes, COLS
    im, figs = page_image()
    vals = {"total": 1234, "absentee": 12, "early": 345, "election_day": 6}
    boxes, label, h = figure_boxes(im, [0, 295, 960, 335], values={c: vals[c] for c in COLS})
    # the ink gives each figure's box (within the strip shrunk by 6 px each side): the figure is 25 px tall
    for c, col in enumerate(COLS):
        b, want = boxes[col], figs[(0, c)]
        assert b is not None and abs(b[0] - want[0]) <= 1 and abs(b[2] - want[2]) <= 1 and abs(b[1] - want[1]) <= 1
    assert label is not None and label[0] == 40 and h == 25
    # a row with fewer clusters than columns: nothing is guessed
    empty, lab, hh = figure_boxes(im, [0, 220, 960, 240], values=None)
    assert all(v is None for v in empty.values()) and lab is None and hh is None
    # widths that do not fit the digits of the values (a 4-digit value that is as wide as a 1-digit one) are not trusted
    odd = figure_boxes(im, [0, 295, 960, 335], values={"total": 1, "absentee": 1234567, "early": 1, "election_day": 1})
    assert all(v is None for v in odd[0].values())


def report_raw():
    cell = lambda r, c, v, y: {"page": 1, "block": "1|1", "contest": "President", "candidate": "A", "row_kind": r, "column": c,
                               "value": v, "first_read": v, "status": "accepted", "tries": 0, "model": "m", "reason": None,
                               "box": [0, y, 950, y + 40]}

    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    im = Image.new("L", (1000, 1400), 255)
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.rectangle([40, 100, 400, 140], fill=0)                       # the contest's title
    dr.rectangle([40, 150, 160, 168], fill=0)                       # "Vote For 1"
    for x in (520, 660, 800, 930):
        dr.rectangle([x - 40, 200, x + 20, 230], fill=0)            # the column headings
    figs = {}
    for r in range(6):
        y = 300 + r * 80                                            # a row pitch of 80 px, the figures 24 px tall
        dr.rectangle([40, y, 300, y + 24], fill=0)                  # the label
        for c, x in enumerate((520, 660, 800, 930)):
            dr.rectangle([x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 10, y + 24], fill=0)
            figs[(r, c)] = [x - 10 * (c + 1), y, x + 11, y + 25]
        dr.line([40, y + 38, 960, y + 38], fill=200, width=1)       # a dotted rule is a faint line
    return im, figs

"""Screenshots for T07c: python3 qa/t07c/shoot.py [states|tabs|replay]. Serves site/ itself; never installs a browser.
Each state at 1440x900 and 390x844 (named <state>-1440.png and <state>-390.png)."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from lib import *
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

W, M = ("1440", (1440, 900)), ("390", (390, 844))
STATES = [("panola-open", ""), ("san-saba-open", "?county=san_saba"), ("san-saba-cannot-verify", "?county=san_saba&finding=f003"),
          ("jones-settled", "?county=jones&finding=f009"), ("jones-cannot-verify", "?county=jones&finding=f001"),
          ("lynn-wrong-column", "?county=lynn&finding=f004"), ("cottle-empty", "?county=cottle"), ("limestone-not-checked", "?county=limestone"),
          ("scurry-open", "?county=scurry")]

def states(b):
    for name, q in STATES:
        for tag, size in (W, M):
            ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, q, wait=3000)
            pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{name}-{tag}.png")); print(name, tag, errs); ctx.close()

def tabs(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=jones", wait=2500)
        pg.locator("#tabs [aria-selected=true]").focus()
        pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-{tag}.png"), clip={"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": size[0], "height": 140})
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"tabs-focus-full-{tag}.png"))
        print("tabs", tag, "focused:", pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent"), "stops:", pg.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button')].filter(b => b.tabIndex === 0).length"), errs)
        ctx.close()

def replay(b):
    for tag, size in (W, M):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, *size, "?county=san_saba", wait=2500)
        pg.get_by_role("button", name="Replay the audit").click()
        pg.wait_for_function("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent.startsWith('Page 2: the printed sum')", timeout=60000)
        pg.wait_for_timeout(1500); pg.keyboard.press("Escape"); pg.wait_for_timeout(300)
        pg.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"san-saba-replay-{tag}.png")); print("replay", tag, pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent"), errs)
        ctx.close()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()
    only = set(sys.argv[1:])
    for name, fn in (("states", states), ("tabs", tabs), ("replay", replay)):
        if not only or name in only: fn(b)
    b.close()
E

def test_row_crops_are_cut_from_the_page_and_every_figure_is_placed(tmp_path):
    from PIL import Image
    from crossfoot.sitebuild import build_rows
    raw = report_raw()
    raw["pages"][0].update(width=1000, height=1400)
    img, figs = page_image()
    vals = (1234, 12, 345, 6)
    for c in raw["cells"]:                       # three rows on the page's first rows: the strips of page_image()
        r = ("A", "B", "Total Votes Cast").index(c["row_kind"])
        c["box"] = [0, 290 + r * 80, 950, 335 + r * 80]
        c["value"] = vals[("total", "absentee", "early", "election_day").index(c["column"])]
    rc, fx, index = build_rows(raw, [(1, "1|1", "B")], [(1, "1|1", "Total Votes Cast")], lambda n: img, lambda n: 1000, lambda n: 0.5,
                               tmp_path, lambda county, n: f"data/rows/{county}-r{n}.webp")
    assert index == {(1, "1|1", "B"): 0} and len(rc) == 1
    r = rc[0]
    assert (r["p"], r["b"], r["r"]) == (1, "1|1", "B") and r["img"] == "data/rows/tiny-r0.webp"
    assert Image.open(tmp_path / "tiny-r0.webp").size == (r["w"], r["h"])
    # every figure is placed inside the crop, in column order (left to right), and sits inside the row's box
    boxes = [r["fb"][c] for c in ("total", "absentee", "early", "election_day")]
    assert all(b is not None for b in boxes) and [b[0] for b in boxes] == sorted(b[0] for b in boxes)
    assert all(r["rb"][1] <= b[1] and b[3] <= r["rb"][3] + 1 and b[2] <= r["w"] for b in boxes)
    assert 0 <= r["pb"][0] < r["pb"][2] <= 500 and 0 < r["pb"][1] < r["pb"][3] <= 700   # in page-image pixels (half of 1000 x 1400)
    # the contest total row has the figures' boxes in page-image pixels, and no crop of its own
    assert fx[(1, "1|1", "Total Votes Cast", "total")] is not None and (1, "1|1", "Total Votes Cast") not in index
    assert [f.name for f in tmp_path.iterdir()] == ["tiny-r0.webp"]

    """qa/t07c/timeline.mjs builds the timelines of San Saba, Jones, Lynn and Cottle from the real data and checks them."""
    import pathlib, shutil, subprocess
    root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if not node or not (root / "site" / "data" / "san_saba.json").exists():
        pytest.skip("needs node and the built county data")
    r = subprocess.run([node, str(root / "qa" / "t07c" / "timeline.mjs")], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=root)

"""Behaviour checks for T07c, results in qa/t07c/checks.json:  python3 qa/t07c/check.py
tabs (one tab stop, arrow keys, ?county=, sideways scroll inside the bar on a small screen), the run line, the states, a whole
replay of San Saba and of Cottle, the loupe's figure size, and the page's width at four window sizes."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, str(__import__("pathlib").Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from lib import *
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

R = {}
def note(k, v): R[k] = v; print(k, json.dumps(v)[:300], flush=True)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    b = p.chromium.launch()
    # tabs
    ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, 1440, 900, "?county=lynn", wait=2500)
    tabs = pg.evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button')].map(b => ({text: b.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim(), stop: b.tabIndex === 0, sel: b.getAttribute('aria-selected')}))")
    note("tabs", tabs)
    note("tab_stops", sum(t["stop"] for t in tabs))
    note("selected_by_query", [t["text"] for t in tabs if t["sel"] == "true"])
    pg.locator("#tabs [aria-selected=true]").focus()
    pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); a = pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()")
    pg.keyboard.press("End"); e = pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()")
    pg.keyboard.press("ArrowRight"); w = pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()")
    pg.keyboard.press("Home"); h = pg.evaluate("document.activeElement.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()")
    note("arrow_keys", {"ArrowRight": a, "End": e, "ArrowRight_wraps": w, "Home": h})
    pg.keyboard.press("Enter"); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    note("enter_opens", {"url": pg.evaluate("location.search"), "selected": pg.evaluate("document.querySelector('#tabs [aria-selected=true]').textContent.replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim()"),
                         "card": pg.evaluate("document.querySelector('#card h2') ? document.querySelector('#card h2').textContent : null")})
    note("run_line", pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('runline').textContent"))
    note("errors_tabs", errs); ctx.close()
    # small screen: the tabs scroll inside the bar, the page does not move
    ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, 390, 844, "?county=foard", wait=2500)
    note("tabs_390", pg.evaluate("(() => { const n = document.getElementById('tabs'); return {scrolls_inside: n.scrollWidth > n.clientWidth, bar_h: document.querySelector('.bar').offsetHeight, page_overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth, tab_h: document.querySelector('#tabs button').offsetHeight}; })()"))
    note("run_line_above_stage_390", pg.evaluate("(() => { const r = document.getElementById('runline').getBoundingClientRect(), s = document.getElementById('stage').getBoundingClientRect(); return {runline_bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), stage_top: Math.round(s.top)}; })()"))
    ctx.close()
    # no sideways scroll
    for w, h in ((1440, 900), (1024, 768), (390, 844), (320, 640)):
        for q in ("", "?county=jones&finding=f009", "?county=cottle", "?county=limestone"):
            ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, w, h, q, wait=1800)
            note(f"overflow_{w}_{q or 'panola'}", pg.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth || document.body.scrollWidth > innerWidth"))
            ctx.close()
    # a one-county build shows no tabs and no run line
    ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900}); pg = ctx.new_page()
    def one(route):
        r = route.fetch(); d = r.json(); d["counties"] = d["counties"][:1]; route.fulfill(response=r, json=d)
    pg.route("**/data/index.json", one); pg.goto(BASE, wait_until="load"); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
    note("one_county", pg.evaluate("({tabs_hidden: document.getElementById('tabs').hidden, runline_hidden: document.getElementById('runline').hidden})")); ctx.close()
    # the loupe at reading size: the ringed figure's height on screen
    for w, h in ((1440, 900), (390, 844), (1440, 650)):
        for q in ("?county=san_saba", "?county=jones&finding=f009", "?county=lynn&finding=f004"):
            ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, w, h, q, wait=2600)
            hh = pg.evaluate("""(() => { const l = document.querySelector('.lp-layer'); const ring = document.querySelector('.lp-ring'); if (!l || !ring) return null;
                const m = new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(l.querySelector('.lp-pan')).transform); const s = m.a;
                const img = l.querySelector('img'); return {scale: +s.toFixed(3), loupe: [document.getElementById('loupe').offsetWidth, document.getElementById('loupe').offsetHeight]}; })()""")
            note(f"loupe_{w}x{h}_{q}", hh); ctx.close()
    # a whole replay: San Saba (rows read again) and Cottle (nothing found)
    for q in ("?county=san_saba", "?county=cottle", "?county=jones"):
        ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, 1440, 900, q, wait=2500)
        pg.keyboard.press("Alt+Shift+P"); pg.wait_for_timeout(500)
        caps = set()
        for _ in range(900):
            caps.add(pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('rp-cap').textContent"))
            if not pg.evaluate("document.body.classList.contains('replaying')"): break
            pg.wait_for_timeout(100)
        pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        note(f"replay_{q}", {"captions_seen": len(caps), "finished": not pg.evaluate("document.body.classList.contains('replaying')"), "errors": errs,
                           "button": pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('replay').textContent"), "headline": pg.evaluate("document.getElementById('fcount').textContent")})
        ctx.close()
    # limestone: replay disabled with the reason
    ctx, pg, errs = open_page(b, 1440, 900, "?county=limestone", wait=2000)
    note("limestone", pg.evaluate("({disabled: document.getElementById('replay').disabled, hint: document.getElementById('replay-hint').textContent, headline: document.getElementById('fcount').textContent, stage: document.getElementById('statebox').textContent})"))
    ctx.close(); b.close()
(OUT / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(R, indent=1))
E
